dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My best wishes to him.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Thank you, and mine to you... If you don't mind, please take this.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: This is called a Windwheel Aster. I asked a friend to bring one back from Mondstadt for me.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: There, this plant symbolizes the "visible winds." I hope it can keep my husband safe at sea.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: You are a good person. I hope that you, too, may be blessed be the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Hello. Would you like to join me in prayer to the Anemo Archon, Barbatos?

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: You worship the Anemo Archon?

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: ...I suppose you rarely meet locals of Liyue who worship the Anemo Archon?

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: ...The reason I do is because my husband is a sailor.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Although it is tradition in Liyue to worship the Geo Archon, it's the wind that ultimately decides whether a ship at sea will return home safely or not. Wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: ...Also, I don't care if he makes any money or not. All I want is to have him back safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: I heard something about that too...

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: It may be because I pray to the Anemo Archon regularly... But I sensed bad tidings on the winds a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Maybe it was selfish of me only to pray for my husband's safety...

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Because now, all of Liyue's people need divine protection.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: *sigh* Anemo or not... any god will do as long as they can keep my husband safe...
